# Draft:Revolutionary Socialist Party (Netherlands - 2025)

----
- I have reviewed Draft:Revolutionary Socialist Party (Netherlands, 2025) before, I don't believe sufficient sources exist. Dajasj (talk) 07:44, 18 May 2025 (UTC)
The Revolutionary Socialist Party (RSP), until 2025 known as The Socialists, is a Dutch revolutionary socialist party. The party originates from a split in the Dutch Socialist Party (SP).
History
The RSP arose from an internal ideological conflict within the Socialist Party. The conflict was predominantly between the party leadership and its left-wing opposition, composed of amongst others ROOD, Communist Platform (CP) and the Marxist Forum. The conflict started about the supposed incompatibility of the political positions of the Communist Platform with the Socialist Party. In October 2020 members of the Communist Platform would get expelled from the party. Since november 2020, the leadership of the Socialist Party severed its ties with its youth-wing, because its chairman, and the majority of it's leadership we're affiliated to the Communist Platform.  In october 2021, both ROOD and the Marxist Forum we're labeled as political parties by the Socialist Party leadership, making dual membership illegal. As a result, more than a hundred members had been expelled.
On the 25th of September 2022 The Socialists organised a first nationwide conference with 140 attendees. At this conference it had been decided that they would start to work towards a nationwide socialist party. At its inception, The Socialists were supported by council members from Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Zaanstad, Assen and Utrecht. ROOD, the former youth wing of the Socialist Party, which was heavily involved in the split, called on its members to join this new party.
On a party congress that took place on March 2025 it had been decided that henceforth the party would be known under the name Revolutionary Socialist Party, in doing so they are aligning themselves with the historical Revolutionary Socialist Party of the Netherlands.
Ideology
The party bases itself mostly on the works of Karl Marx, his allies and ideological offspring, without a strong preference for any specific current. The party is explicitly non-Stalinist, and has a strong emphasis on internal democracy, probably as a result of it's past as a minority group.
Activism
The party is very active, together with it's youth branch, in anti-NATO activism and protests leading up to a summit in The Hague in 2025.
In May 2025 activists of the party squatted a building during a protest for better living conditions in Utrecht.
Elections
Shortly after the split some local groups later affiliated with the RSP would participate in the municipal elections of 2022, none of these groups managed to secure any seats.
